parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of the molecules of the gas is $1900\text{ m s}^{-1}$ when $pV$ is equal to $270\text{ J}$.

Determine the mass, in $\text{u}$, of one molecule of the gas, where $\text{u}$ is the unified atomic mass unit.
